subject: [PATCH 28/60] mm: select memory features per node

reviews.author: Gregory Relay
reviews.summary: Reviewer noted that node_memory_features_valid() is not called in the hotplug path when memory is onlined, potentially allowing invalid features to be set for a node.

2026-11-20.patch_summary: This patch introduces the ability to select memory features per node in the Linux kernel. It adds a new field, `memory_features`, to the `pg_data_t` struct to store a bit mask indicating whether a node's memory is common or private. The patch also updates various functions and macros to handle this new feature, including node state publishing and validation. This change allows for more flexibility in managing memory features on a per-node basis, which can be useful in certain scenarios such as NUMA systems without node 0 holding all memory.
